summary: template returns sha1 checksum, dest, ownership ids and names, md5sum when changed, mode, size and the temporary src on the target.
questions: How do I get the checksum of a rendered template?
What does the template module return?

answer_card.title: template return values
answer_card.answer_md:
- `checksum` (sha1), `md5sum` (when changed)
- `dest`, `size`, `mode`
- `owner`/`uid`, `group`/`gid`
- `src`: temp source on target (when changed)
